# WaKit — Free Private WhatsApp Utilities in Your Browser

> WaKit (https://wakit.progeni.live) is a fast, 100% client-side web utility suite for WhatsApp tasks. All processing runs locally inside the user's browser using HTML5 Canvas, the Web Crypto API, and WebAssembly (FFmpeg compiled to Wasm). Files, videos, audio recordings, phone numbers, and messages are never uploaded to a WaKit server.

Last updated: 2026-10-25
Canonical home: https://wakit.progeni.live/
Publisher: Progeni (https://progeni.live)
Contact: support@progeni.live
Privacy: https://wakit.progeni.live/privacy-policy
Full model guide: https://wakit.progeni.live/llms-full.txt

## Core facts

- Processing model: 100% client-side; no media upload endpoint and no account required.
- Price: free, no signup, no watermark, no usage limit.
- Best for: WhatsApp status clips, wa.me links, QR codes, and audio files above the 16 MB chat attachment cap.
- Platforms: modern desktop and mobile browsers with WebAssembly support (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox).
- Not affiliated with WhatsApp LLC or Meta Platforms, Inc.

## Primary tools

### 1. WhatsApp Status Video Splitter
- URL: https://wakit.progeni.live/whatsapp-status-splitter
- What it does: cuts MP4, MOV, or WebM videos into exact 30-second segments for WhatsApp status.
- Technical detail: FFmpeg WebAssembly uses stream copy (-c copy) where possible, so the split is fast and avoids unnecessary re-encoding.
- Best for: long videos that need to fit WhatsApp's 30-second status limit.

### 2. Send WhatsApp Message Without Saving Number (Direct Chat)
- URL: https://wakit.progeni.live/direct-chat-without-saving-number
- What it does: builds official wa.me links so anyone can start a chat without adding the contact to their phonebook.
- Features: country-code picker, E.164 normalization, prefilled message support, and a copyable link.
- Best for: delivery updates, marketplace sellers, customer support, and one-time messages.

### 3. WhatsApp Link and QR Code Generator
- URL: https://wakit.progeni.live/whatsapp-qr-code-generator
- What it does: creates scan-to-chat WhatsApp QR codes, shareable wa.me links, Wi-Fi QR codes, and payment QR codes.
- Features: custom colors, logo badge, live preview, and PNG/SVG export generated on-device.
- Best for: shops, service businesses, events, and contactless payments.

### 4. Compress Audio for WhatsApp (3 GB input, 16 MB output)
- URL: https://wakit.progeni.live/whatsapp-audio-compressor
- What it does: transcodes MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, and OGG recordings up to 3 GB into smaller files under WhatsApp's 16 MB attachment cap.
- Presets: 64 kbps for voice notes, 96 kbps for balanced audio, and 128 kbps for music.
- Output formats: universal MP3 or WhatsApp-native OPUS/OGG.
- Technical detail: the source file is mounted read-only in FFmpeg's virtual filesystem, so it is not copied into RAM first. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a Web Worker so the interface stays responsive.

## Common questions

- Are my files uploaded? No. Media stays on the device and is processed by WebAssembly locally.
- Is there a file-size limit? The audio compressor accepts source files up to 3 GB. Processing time and success depend on available browser memory; mobile devices work best with files under 150 MB. WhatsApp itself caps chat attachments at 16 MB.
- Do I need to install anything? No. The tools run in the browser with no extension or app.
- Does the status splitter reduce quality? It uses stream copy when the input codecs are compatible, which avoids re-encoding and preserves the original video quality.
- Can I use these tools commercially? Yes, for lawful content. Do not upload copyrighted video you do not own or send spam.
